exposure: foetal weight of more than 2.8 kg
cohort: The study included 249 subjects with singleton pregnancy, gestational age of 37 weeks or more, past dates, or pregnancies complicated with medical comorbidities, who underwent induction of labor.
finding: Maternal age >30 years, primiparity, obesity, induction time longer than 12 hours, foetal weight >2.8 kg, and a lower Bishop score were significantly associated with an increased risk of failed induction of labour.
